title: Robust Reasoning as a Symmetry-Protected Topological Phase
text: For the generalization experiment (Fig. 2 ), we employed a progressive curriculum where the maximum sequence length increased linearly from L = 10 L=10 to L = 50 L=50 over the first 70% of training steps. In the final phase, sampling was biased towards the maximum length ( L = 50 L=50 ) to enforce asymptotic stability before extrapolation to L = 5000 L=5000 .
